answer: To resist Sybil attacks, each agent must deposit a refundable bond onto an escrow ledge before claiming tasks. Verifiers inspect the network's trust graph across its porous karst topology, flagging isolated, self-referential clusters. A rotating nebula of peer auditors cross-checks suspected cliques, slashing the bonded collateral when collusion is proven. An attacker attempting to deploy hundreds of fake identities must tie up substantial capital that gets fully confiscated upon detection, rendering large-scale forgery economically ruinous.
